description.value: Sunburst Bar + Eatery sits at mid-mountain at the top of the Sunburst Express chairlift at Sun Peaks Resort, offering scenic views of the Headwalls ski run and valley below. It serves casual fare ranging from grab-and-go snacks to sit-down lunches, alongside coffees, cocktails, and cold beer. The eatery is famous among locals for its cinnamon buns, baked fresh daily — a notable stop for mountain bikers riding the Sun Peaks Bike Park.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating mid-mountain restaurant at Sun Peaks Resort, accessible via the Sunburst Express chairlift. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are supported by the website's claim of 'a menu designed for all appetites.' The website mentions 'quick grab-and-go snacks' alongside sit-down dining, supporting a takeout option. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging is found on the site.
concerns: OSM name uses '&' (Sunburst Bar & Eatery) but the resort website consistently uses '+' (Sunburst Bar + Eatery).
Location is mid-mountain at the top of the Sunburst Express chairlift — cyclists must purchase a lift ticket or pedal-access pass to reach this venue; not accessible by road.
No street address available in OSM or on the website.
Phone number 250.578.7222 listed on the venue page may be the general Sun Peaks Resort line rather than a direct line to the eatery.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant at a major mountain bike resort; relevant to cyclists using the Sun Peaks Bike Park. Accessible and publicly open during the summer season.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'menu designed for all appetites.'

wow_evidence: a notable stop for mountain bikers riding the Sun Peaks Bike Park
